diagnosis: Three raw malformed Provider responses consistently omitted JSON string quotes around the long whyThisObservationDiscriminates field (and sometimes predictedDecisionChange), despite correctly quoting neighboring fields. This is a Provider/tool-argument representation failure under the long structured audit form, not evidence about the stopping hypothesis.
worldModelPressure: A research discipline can become less tractable when its mechanical structured representation is verbose enough to destabilize Provider Tool serialization. Semantic discipline and wire representation must be distinguished.
correction: Preserve exactly the same required semantic commitments but encode the per-observation audit as short plain-text fields: alts, decision, discriminator, decisionChange. Preserve submit commitments as alts, remainingDiscriminator, stopReason. No field is removed semantically; only names/shape are shortened, and alternatives are serialized as one compact string instead of an array.
scientificDisposition: The malformed attempts remain invalid apparatus evidence and are excluded from HP2 outcome statistics.
